name: Ezekiel Elias
source:
Live for a good time not for a long time is Zeke's policy, which has allowed him to attempt incredibly dangerous stunts most people have the self preservation to not pursue. He's standoffish and, has, something of an ego, often seeing himself as more of a 'man' than others. He also hates when people call him 'Ezekiel', so let's make sure to do it a lot.

He's quick to make his opinion known despite potential social consequences, which has caused him to get into conflict with various Prisoners, He only seems to get along with a small handful of his fellow prisoners, having a particular soft spot for one of them...

When interrogated about his crime he got aggressive, displaying little empathy and moreso annoyance that it was even considered a crime. Monitor him closely.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Ezekiel_'Zeke'_Elias]Wiki[/url]]
